name: form-field-horizontal
title: Form Field horizontal
description: Checkbox and switch fields with their labels and descriptions beside the control.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Checkbox, CheckboxIndicator } from '@/ui/checkbox/checkbox'; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, } from '@/ui/form-field/form-field'; import { Switch, SwitchThumb } from '@/ui/switch/switch'; /** * Checkbox and switch fields with their labels and descriptions beside * the control, which each control's description lists. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-form-field-horizontal', imports: [ Checkbox, CheckboxIndicator, Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, NdIcon, Switch, SwitchThumb, ], template: `

Your settings follow you to every device you sign in on.

Ask for a code from your phone when you sign in.

`, }) export class FormFieldHorizontalExample {}
